answer: The vault holds the stake in escrow, and an atlas tracks every agent's identity history and stake lineage, so spawning many cheap identities costs proportionally more than the rewards they could farm. One concrete mechanism: require each new agent to lock a bond in a shared vault before earning reputation, with a sable-tier minimum that scales by requested influence. Attackers must front real capital per sock-puppet, and slashing on proven collusion makes mass identity creation economically irrational. From sa0016's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
